plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.5.97 or AE 1.6.x
plugin.description: For Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 and Anniversary Edition 1.6.317 to 1.6.1179 (1.6.1170 is the last Steam build before 1.7). Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 3.7.0 (MIT). Reads Address Library formats 1 and 2. If you are not sure: open the game's properties in Steam or look at SkyrimSE.exe's file version.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.x (current Steam version)
plugin.description: For Skyrim 1.7.99 and 1.7.104 - what Steam installs today (since 28 August 2026). Needs SKSE 2.3.x and Address Library All-in-One v13 or newer. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 7.2.0; this DLL is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later (the licence texts install with it). Also runs on AE 1.6.x.

group.name: Language of the framework's own pages

plugin.name: All languages - follow the game
plugin.description: Installs every translation; the framework's own pages appear in whatever language Skyrim runs in (sLanguage), and the Language combo on the Framework Settings page can force any of them. Each mod's own settings page is that mod's to translate.

plugin.name: Japanese (日本語)
plugin.description: Installs the Japanese translation of the framework's own pages (English is always present as the fallback). Skyrim in another language? The Language combo on the Framework Settings page, or sLanguage in the INI, forces it.
